Lonza is looking for new staff to join its growing GMP Warehouse and Logistics team! As a world leading contract development and manufacturing organisation (CDMO) Lonza is looking to people with a passion to help others and committed to delivering excellence for our customers patients. Our mission is to bring life changing medicines to patients and that requires a strong team with a passion for quality and excellence. If you are looking for a dynamic job where you can proudly make a difference for patient lives, take a look at our Warehouse and Logistics job openings to join our growing team at Lonza Netherlands. The actual location of this job is in Geleen, Netherlands. About Lonza: At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone's ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that's the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're ready to help turn our customers' breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now! What We Are Looking For: Preferably, some experience in a clean environment, e.g. nursing, pharmacy, HACCP-regulated environments/restaurants, or a general understanding of working in a sterile environment. Moving and handling materials. SAP knowledge would be appreciated but is not essential. Good English skills. Willingness to work in gowns/protective clothing (masks, gloves, goggles). Candidates cannot have too many piercings. Physically demanding and sometimesuncomfortable work. Strong planning and prioritization skills. Positive, reliable, and proactive attitude. Good problem-solving skills. Current working hours: 08:00–16:00, Monday–Sunday. This will change to a shift system:1st shift: 06:00–14:00 2nd shift: 12:00–20:00 What you will get: An agile career and dynamic working culture. An inclusive and ethical workplace where your ideas are valued. Compensation programs that recognize high performance. A comprehensive range of benefits based on your role and location. Opportunities to develop your technical expertise in GMP manufacturing and advanced therapy production. A collaborative team environment focused on continuous improvement. €2,650 salary + 15% shift allowance + 8% bonus. Functieomschrijving As a Production Support Logistics Operator, you will ensure the timely supply of materials, perform critical production support activities, and help maintain the highest standards of quality, safety, and GMP compliance. This is a fully site-based role. Working together in person supports close, real-time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards. What You Will Do: Perform production support activities, including material staging, disinfection, cleaning, and restocking. Ensure materials and equipment are available to support manufacturing operations. Operate decontamination equipment, including autoclaves and Vaporized Hydrogen Peroxide (VHP) chambers. Dispose of waste in accordance with GMP and site procedures. Maintain clean, organized, and safe work areas. Follow GMP requirements and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Report deviations, equipment issues, or safety concerns to the supervisor. Collaborate with Manufacturing and other departments to ensure efficient production support.
